logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of Alexander and Juliana standing side by side before the altar, their hands tightly clasped beneath the soaring stained-glass windows.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Alexander holds Juliana's hand resolutely as Juliana gazes toward the church aisle where the intrusion unfolds.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of an elderly noblewoman seated in the pew, clutching her chest with anxious apprehension.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine in her lavish bridal gown, her fists clenched tightly in silent fury.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot down the ruined nave aisle as the High Priest marches forward flanked by armed royal guards with halberds.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Heavy armored footsteps and boots crunching against loose stone debris.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Authoritative)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Commanding)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: None shall leave until every witness is accounted for.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Cold, Accusatory)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: You married this woman as a nameless beggar...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scornful, Harsh)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: ...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Resonant, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gravely, Firm)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: She married the man... not the title.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Harsh, Derisive)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Rigid, Formal)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S.) (Sharp)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: No licensed clergyman presided...

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Scathing)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.

segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.

segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.

segments.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

segments.label: JULIANA (Voice Breaking, Passionate)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: A church called me unworthy.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.

segments.label: JULIANA (O.S.) (Bitter)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: A church chained me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.

segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

segments.label: JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Malicious, Taunting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Threatening)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning)
segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
segments.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: The High Priest turns sharply on his heel and strides past the guards toward the church exit.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Shuffling boots and clattering armor as the royal guards turn and retreat down the ruined aisle.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Slow pan to Catherine standing in her bridal gown beside the sunlit aisle, watching the priest depart before turning to camera with a wicked, predatory smile.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Malicious)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Ten days is plenty of time.
